patterns.master_prompt_usage: MASTER_PROMPTs are used 'once per project' to lock architecture, conventions, and AI usage rules. They should generate ARCHITECTURE.md at the repo root.
patterns.pipeline_expectation: Pipeline Phase 1 expects to read PROJECT_MAP.md and ARCHITECTURE.md before starting. If absent, it should create PROJECT_MAP.md in Phase 7.
patterns.bootstrap_requirement: New projects without existing ARCHITECTURE.md need the MASTER_PROMPT to generate it gracefully, not fail.

existing_implementations.description: The MASTER_PROMPTs mention creating ARCHITECTURE.md but don't have explicit instructions for the new-project path when these files don't exist yet.
existing_implementations.gap_identified: The new-project bootstrap flow has never been tested. The pipeline expects files that don't exist in new projects.

investigation_scope.test_approach: Create minimal test projects for each stack, run MASTER_PROMPTs, identify failures, document issues, then fix
